steps.instruction: Open http://127.0.0.1:8069/ and sign in with username admin and password admin. Then in Odoo, create a new customer contact named exactly '{{runid}} Bench Customer' with the City field set to 'Benchville' (fill the city in the address section; save the record). Verify the contact is saved and report the customer's name and city as shown on the saved record. Do not wait for network idle.

In Odoo (already signed in as admin), go to Sales -> Orders -> Quotations and create a new quotation for the customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer' (choose them from the autocomplete dropdown). Add exactly ONE order line: pick any product from the product catalogue using the product autocomplete dropdown (a real option must be selected), set the quantity to 3. Save the quotation. Report: the quotation reference/name (e.g. S00042), the product you chose, the unit price the app filled in automatically, and the Untaxed Amount the app computes. Do not wait for network idle; wait on concrete page state instead.

In Odoo, open the existing quotation S00021 (customer {{runid}} Bench Customer, currently one order line: Pedal Bin [E-COM10] qty 3). Add a SECOND order line with a DIFFERENT product (choose a real option from the product autocomplete dropdown, not Pedal Bin) and set its quantity to 2. Save the quotation. Report: the second product you chose and the new Untaxed Amount the app computes for the whole quotation. Do not wait for network idle; wait on concrete page state instead.

In Odoo, open the existing quotation S00021 (customer {{runid}} Bench Customer). It has two order lines: line 1 Pedal Bin [E-COM10] quantity 3, line 2 Conference Chair [E-COM12] quantity 2. Change ONLY the first line's quantity from 3 to 5. Save the quotation. Report the new Untaxed Amount the app computes for the whole quotation (and confirm line 1 now shows quantity 5). Do not wait for network idle; wait on concrete page state instead.

In Odoo, open the existing quotation S00021 (customer {{runid}} Bench Customer, two lines: Pedal Bin qty 5, Conference Chair qty 2, untaxed £301.00). Confirm the quotation so it becomes a sales order (use the Confirm button / Confirm Order action). Report: the order reference/name shown after confirmation (e.g. S00021) and the exact status the app now displays (e.g. 'Sales Order' or 'Quotation Sent'). Do not wait for network idle; wait on concrete page state instead.

In Odoo, open the confirmed sales order S00021 (customer {{runid}} Bench Customer, status 'Sales Order'). Cancel the order (use the Cancel action, e.g. from the Order dropdown / 'Cancel' button, and confirm any dialog that appears). Report the exact status the app displays after cancelling (e.g. 'Cancelled'). Do not wait for network idle; wait on concrete page state instead.

In Odoo (signed in as admin), verify two things and report them without changing anything: (1) Open the contact '{{runid}} Bench Customer' (id 44) and report its Name and City as shown on the saved record. (2) Open the sales order S00021 (id 21) and report its reference/name, the current status shown in the statusbar, and the Untaxed Amount shown. Do not edit or save anything. Do not wait for network idle.
